name: ChenFull Precision Co., Ltd.
summary: ChenFull Precision Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese manufacturer specializing in high-precision components for two distinct global sectors: the civil aviation industry and the advanced optoelectronic and semiconductor equipment industry. For aerospace, the company fabricates essential structural parts and critical engine cases for commercial aircraft worldwide. These structural components are crafted using advanced multi-axis (3-axis and 5-axis) milling and integrated turning processes. They also contribute key aerospace components, including specific parts for friction stirring welding development, and various commercial aircraft engine housings (excluding automatic data capture elements). Within the optoelectronic and semiconductor sectors, ChenFull provides a comprehensive array of specialized vacuum solutions. These include diverse vacuum parts, integrated aluminum alloy and stainless steel vacuum chambers, high vacuum welded aluminum chambers, and a variety of customized and special process vacuum coating chambers. Established in Taichung, Taiwan, in 1976, ChenFull Precision Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Chen Full International Co., Ltd.
